title: Seagrove "Time Well Spent" 109 Santa Clara Street
h1: Seagrove "Time Well Spent" 109 Santa Clara Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- 3-minute walk or less to beach- Santa Clara access is ADA accessible via ramp and has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season- Private pool**Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $35 per day** - 2-minute drive to Publix in WaterColor Shopping Center- Short bike ride to Seaside or favorite local restaurants, Cafe 30A, Surfing Deer, and Market Cafe- Game room featuring PacMan machine, Atari games, & foosball Table- 2 Refrigerators and 2 dishwashers- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 6 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Indulgent poolside days and effortless beach fun? That’s Time Well Spent! Designed for relaxing vacations, this 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach home sleeps 20 guests. Enjoy a stunning outdoor oasis, complete with a sparkling pool and a game room equipped for making memories. With the beach within a 3-minute walk and local restaurants less than a mile away, this home promises convenient Emerald Coast living!Beautiful finishes and cool neutrals await inside this 3-story beach home. In the kitchen, style meets function with quartz countertops, double dishwashers, and both a standard coffee maker and a Keurig. A large dining table hosts 8 comfortably, plus 4 bar stools at the island offer additional seating. The space flows into the adjacent living area, where 2 soft sofas and an armchair flank the TV. Out the back door, dine alfresco at the 6-seat table or recline on the outdoor sectional beneath the overhead fan while enjoying the pool’s melodic water feature. Sun loungers, palm trees, and a well-maintained privacy fence add the finishing touches to the idyllic setting. A dedicated laundry room adds convenience for post-swim cleanup and extended stays. When it’s time to retire, find a king bed and private bathroom in the first-level guest bedroom—all the bedrooms feature a Smart TV.On the second level, discover 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed, 1 guest bedroom with a king bed plus a twin-over-twin bunk bed, and 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms.The third-floor game room features a Pac-Man machine and a foosball table for competitive fun. Meanwhile, the 75-inch Smart TV and the oversized sectional—paired with a Blu-ray player and family-friendly movie library—make this a great space for movie marathons. With 2 full-over-full built-in bunk beds, it’s perfect for kids, teens, and adults young in spirit. There’s even a furnished balcony for enjoying fresh air and nature views! This floor also has 1 guest bedroom with a king bed, a twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a private bathroom.Time Well Spent has everything guests need for a dream Seagrove Beach vacation, including on-site parking, 6 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle for easy exploring! Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is right down Santa Clara Street, across the Scenic 30A Highway. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bath- Game Room Bunks: Two Full over Full Built-in Bunk beds*Construction in the area is expected to continue through 2026
